fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) analyst fair value raised from $395.57 to $408.36, with bulls citing AI, autonomous driving, and SpaceX merger as bases for $460–550 price targets.
fields.summary_ko.1: Bears point to cash burn, high capital expenditure, and execution risks of Robotaxi, Cybercab, and Optimus with $130–420 price targets; Philips Securities maintains $230 target with sell rating.
fields.summary_ko.2: Revenue growth modeled at 21.41% (previously 16.98%), net margin 9.59% (previously 8.69%), forward P/E adjusted to 92.81x (previously 177.90x).
